item.title: Week 10: Jaguars at Titans
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: JAX -10.5 · O/U 45.5 | Model TEN 21% vs. market 17% | On paper Jacksonville has the edge (Jacksonville ranks 3rd in EPA per dropback, +0.29). Under center, Trevor Lawrence ranks 2nd of 31 in EPA per dropback and Cam Ward ranks 26th; x-factor: Parker Washington gets 24% of Jacksonville's targets and 33% of its air yards, and His WOPR (0.59) ranks 24th of 1211. Tennessee's pass defense ranks 30th. The model favors Jacksonville at 79%, mostly on passing matchup (6.2 pts) and starting QB (3.1 pts).
